posts.title: Feeding Red Meat to the MAHA Lions
posts.description: Some science journalists have been complaining about the new food pyramid. When asked for evidence for their support for low red meat consumption they cited an old JAMA Int Med analysis. I am certainly not MAHA but I think these sort of guidelines, in either direction, are foolish and a diversion from far more important... Click here to continue reading...

posts.title: Skeptics and the Pandemic
posts.description: I recently posted the following thread on Twitter: I am so disappointed by the large number of pre-pandemic medical skeptics who have now turned into mask/vaccine skeptics. I largely agreed with many of them back in the day. /1 Pre-pandemic they used their skills and intelligence to rightfully question whether, say, a stent should be inserted... posts.title: Should the ACC Have a Live Meeting?
posts.description: I was surprised to learn from a recent press release that the American College of Cardiology is planning to have some live participants at its annual scientific sessions meeting in May. The college said it is also partnering with a technology company to offer these participants a wearable monitoring device “as an added safety measure... Click here to continue reading...
